author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: clear 'AD' letters over a smooth fluid wave; validates cleanly. Without the 'BLUE' line, 'AD' plus a wave does not identify AdBlue on its own, so this is kept as an attempt, not a fix.
omissions: The second text line 'BLUE' is omitted: at SOLO48 separate letters need 8-unit centerline gaps, so four capitals need about 24 units of gaps plus about 28 of letter widths, more than the 36-unit width, and a second 16-unit text line does not fit above the wave either.
drawing_plan: Hand-authored arched A and round D on an 18-unit cap band; three half-ellipse wave arcs across the full width.
